_about: BDU's curated mockup templates. Paths are relative to the templates folder (Design/Resources/ocha_claude_skills_BDU/mockups in the OCHA DMU Dropbox, git-ignored). The templates are licensed files: never copy them into this skill, a repository or a job folder. Every entry was rendered with a test card and looked at before it was added. design_slots names the smart-object layers that take the design (beats the name guess); background is the default colour for a plain background layer; area fixes the part of the smart object the design fills; hide_layers hides the template author's credit text or an old sample pasted over the smart object.

magazine-a4-flat.title: A4 magazine or report, front cover, flat and front-facing, light grey
magazine-a4-flat.notes: The approved cover-options look (OCHA Annual Report 2025). Grey #D6D6D6 matches earlier BDU mockup exports; --background keep gives the template's white.

magazine-a4-spread.title: A4 magazine or report open at a spread, front-facing, gentle page curve
magazine-a4-spread.format: Two A4 portrait pages, 2 slots (left, right), 4801x3599 px
magazine-a4-spread.notes: Give a PDF and the first page of the spread: --design report.pdf#4 puts pages 4 and 5 left and right.

magazine-a4-perspective.title: A4 magazine or report cover on a stack, in perspective

a4-page.title: Single A4 page (flyer, letter, one-pager), front-facing with a soft shadow

laptop-website.title: Website on a laptop (MacBook Pro), in perspective, white background
laptop-website.notes: Give a screenshot at 16:10 (e.g. 2560x1600 px). A 16:9 screenshot loses about 10% at the sides.

phone-app.title: App or mobile website on a phone held in a hand, white background
phone-app.notes: Give a phone screenshot at about 9:16. The phone is an older iPhone model.

poster-a-portrait.title: A-size poster (A0-A4 portrait) hanging on a grey wall with clips

poster-a-landscape.title: A-size poster in landscape hanging on a grey wall with clips

poster-square.title: Square poster hanging on a grey wall with clips

business-card-us.title: One US-size business card (3.5x2 in) on a stone ledge, dark background
business-card-us.notes: US size. A European 85x55 mm card (1.55:1) would be cropped about 12%: there is no EU-size template yet.

business-cards-us-front-back.title: US-size business cards: a stack showing the front, one card leaning showing the back
business-cards-us-front-back.format: 3.5x2 in landscape (1.75:1), 2 slots (1 stack top, 2 leaning card), 3000x2250 px
business-cards-us-front-back.notes: Give a 2-page PDF (front, back) or a --spec. US size only.

rollup-85x200.title: Roll-up banner 85x200 cm, front view, light background
rollup-85x200.notes: Small canvas (1600x2500): fine for screens and slides.

rollup-100x200.title: Roll-up banner 100x200 cm, front view, light background
rollup-100x200.notes: Small canvas (1600x2500): fine for screens and slides.
